tools.name: find_directories
tools.title: Find startup directories
tools.description: Search StarTap's hand-checked list of 100+ startup directories, launch platforms and web directories that have a free way to list a product. Each result has its submit URL, Domain Rating by Ahrefs where it was checked, whether it needs an account or a badge, the review wait and notes. Use it to plan where to submit or launch a product, or to find first backlinks. Terms change often, so tell the user to read each submit page before relying on a row.

kind.description: Only these types: launch (launch platforms), directory (product directories), web (classic web directories), gallery (design galleries).

no_account.description: Only directories whose free path needs no account or sign-in.

no_required_badge.description: Leave out directories that require their badge or a backlink on the user's site.

min_dr.description: Only directories with an independently checked Domain Rating of at least this. Directories without a checked rating are left out.

search.description: Words that must each start a word in the name or notes, such as "AI" or "Europe".

limit.description: At most this many results, in StarTap's list order. By default every match is returned.
